intro: Lesson 13: Air pollution and acid rain. Plan or write in each box.

parts.text: Step 1: burning fuel releases sulfur dioxide. Step 2: the gas dissolves in water droplets in clouds, forming acid. Step 3: acid rain falls, often far away.
